game.q: why did the rabbis care so much about the order?
opts: they skipped the terms and conditions

wrong.terms: kind of. but it wasn’t careless. it was trust.
wrong.ring: it does sound good. that’s not why.

game.right: YES. usually it’s explain, then i’ll do it. they put “we will do” first.

end.line: a whole people said yes before they understood: we will do, and we will hear.
end.l1: thunder, a horn, a shaking camp.
end.l2: they said: we will do, and we will hear.

cliff.s1: every morning, bread on the desert floor.
cliff.s2: then one morning there’s none, and that’s the gift.
cliff.tmr: tomorrow: the day the bread didn’t fall.

share: thunder. a horn. then they said yes. the story on infinite hill
